highlights: The Green Lion G-Master 2 Smart Watch is your cool gadget for staying connected throughout your day! Using that, you receive notifications for calls, emails, SMS, and WhatsApp simply. It got 210mAh Lithium-ion Polymer Battery and can endure for a long time.

Enjoy the 1.51" IPS Screen and clear 360*360 Pixel resolution every time you check the time on your wrist. Bluetooth 5.0 technology gives you a smooth and reliable connectivity which always keeps you paired without interruption.

Green Lion Smart Watch monitors your heart health 24h while the vibration support ensures you never miss an alert. You have wireless charging and a nice chain steel strap so it's as stylish as it is functional.

Lightweight at just 60g, you feel as if this watch is a part of your body. Moreover, you can rest assured about the durability and elegance with alloy vacuum plating case. Multiple NFC capabilities and an always-on display feature are also there to make this gadget a perfect accessory for every moment of your day.
Notifications: Calls, Email, SMS, WhatsApp Etc.
